page: Microsoft Azure EC2as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the ECasv6 server family. Powered by an AMD processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server configuration features 2 dedicated virtual CPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory. This allocation provides a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core, making it suitable for memory-intensive tasks.

The EC2as_v6 instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached volumes. It is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance persistent disks. Additionally, this configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and it does not feature any GPU hardware accelerators.

With a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is designed for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallel processing power. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention. It is suitable for small-scale databases, caching layers, memory-optimized enterprise applications, and lightweight data processing tasks that fit within a 16.0 GB memory footprint.
